import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import re
import os
import warnings
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.calibration import CalibratedClassifierCV
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
from scipy.sparse import hstack

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Encode target labels
label_map = {"EAP": 0, "HPL": 1, "MWS": 2}
train_df["label"] = train_df["author"].map(label_map)

# Split training data for validation
X_train_full = train_df["text"].values
y_train_full = train_df["label"].values
X_test = test_df["text"].values

# Split for validation
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_full, y_train_full, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train_full
)

# TF-IDF Vectorization
tfidf = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=10000, ngram_range=(1, 2), stop_words="english", min_df=2, max_df=0.95
)

# Fit on training data only
tfidf.fit(X_train)

# Transform
X_train_tfidf = tfidf.transform(X_train)
X_val_tfidf = tfidf.transform(X_val)
X_test_tfidf = tfidf.transform(X_test)

# Train classifier with calibration
base_clf = LogisticRegression(
    C=1.0,
    max_iter=1000,
    solver="lbfgs",
    multi_class="multinomial",
    random_state=42,
    n_jobs=-1,
)

clf = CalibratedClassifierCV(base_clf, method="sigmoid", cv=3)
clf.fit(X_train_tfidf, y_train)

# Predict on validation set
val_probs = clf.predict_proba(X_val_tfidf)
val_pred_labels = np.argmax(val_probs, axis=1)

# Compute log loss
val_log_loss = log_loss(y_val, val_probs)
print(f"Validation log loss: {val_log_loss:.6f}")

# Train final model on full training data
clf.fit(X_train_full, y_train_full)

# Predict on test set
test_probs = clf.predict_proba(X_test_tfidf)

# Format submission
submission_df = sample_submission.copy()
submission_df["EAP"] = test_probs[:, 0]
submission_df["HPL"] = test_probs[:, 1]
submission_df["MWS"] = test_probs[:, 2]

# Save submission
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
